generated_steps.text: Place the adult mouse whole brain, already fixed in 4% PFA, in 1× PBS for thorough washing to remove residual fixative. (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 3 × 1 hour)

Place the brain tissue in blocking solution (5% (vol/vol) normal donkey serum + 0.2% Triton X-100 + 0.1% (wt/vol) NaN₃ in 1× PBS) for oscillating blocking. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)

Place the brain tissue in a solution containing anti-β-III Tubulin (TUJ1) rabbit polyclonal antibody (diluted 1:500 in blocking solution) and incubate with gentle oscillation. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 48 hours)
Wash with PBST to remove unbound primary antibody. (Temperature: RT, Time: 5 × 1 hour)

Place the brain tissue in a solution containing donkey anti-rabbit Alexa Fluor 647 secondary antibody (diluted 1:500 in blocking solution) and incubate with oscillation protected from light. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 48 hours)
Wash with PBST to remove unbound secondary antibody. (Temperature: RT, Time: 5 × 1 hour)
Final wash with 1× PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 × 30 min)

Place the brain tissue in 50% (vol/vol) THF (tetrahydrofuran) aqueous solution (adjusted to pH 9–10 with NaOH to protect fluorescent proteins) for oscillating dehydration. (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 1 hour)
Place the brain tissue in 70% (vol/vol) THF aqueous solution (pH 9–10) for oscillating dehydration. (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 1 hour)
Place the brain tissue in 80% (vol/vol) THF aqueous solution (pH 9–10) for oscillating dehydration. (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 1 hour)
Place the brain tissue in 100% THF (anhydrous, pH 9–10, with a small amount of NaOH added) for oscillating dehydration, first time. (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 1 hour)
Place the brain tissue in 100% THF (anhydrous, pH 9–10) for oscillating dehydration, second time (replace with fresh THF). (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 1 hour)

Place the brain tissue in BABB (benzyl alcohol:benzyl benzoate = 1:2, vol/vol) with oscillation to complete de-lipidation and begin RI matching, until the tissue is completely transparent (usually 30–60 min). (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 1 hour)

Transfer the transparent brain tissue to fresh BABB (RI ≈ 1.56), let it stand protected from light to equilibrate, ensuring the tissue is completely transparent and free of bubbles. (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 2 hours)
Replace with fresh BABB again, confirm the tissue is completely transparent, and prepare for imaging. (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 30 min)

Transfer the transparent brain tissue to BABB in a sample holder compatible with the light-sheet microscope sample slot, use a refractive index-matched immersion medium (RI = 1.56) to fix the sample position, and avoid bubbles. (Temperature: RT, Time: Immediate imaging)

If short-term storage is required, seal the sample in BABB and store protected from light at 4 ℃ (imaging is recommended to be completed within 1 week to prevent fluorescence signal decay). (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: ≤ 7 days)
